expectedRealization.rationale: Exceptional Q1 electronics earnings and favorable price breadth can continue over 60d, but very high forward multiples require proof that growth duration exceeds the already-premium baseline.

acceptableExpressionSet.rationale: GigaDevice had exceptional realized growth and favorable price confirmation, but ~109x 2020E PE plus weakening server-DRAM duration make expectation fit only mixed.
Will Semi also had exceptional realized earnings and strong relative price, but high forward valuation embeds substantial growth duration.

changeHypothesis.summary: Electronics manufacturing profits and two leading chip names showed extraordinary realized Q1 growth. The company engines are real, but the market already assigns very high forward multiples and the server-DRAM physical cycle was losing duration, so company growth must not be conflated with a generic memory upcycle.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Domestic semiconductor substitution and product growth can persist, but the frozen evidence does not prove that premium growth exceeds an already-high multi-year baseline.
disconfirmingEvidence: Both names had already outperformed CSI300 strongly over 60d.
Server-DRAM expected 2H price upside had been revised down.

causalChain.mechanism: Strong semiconductor product demand and acquired/product portfolio growth convert into high revenue/profit growth.
Premium-growth equities outperform only if multi-year earnings duration beats the already-high valuation baseline.
causalChain.failureMode: earnings meet forecasts but multiple compresses

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: Exceptional Q1 growth was public and both stocks had already rerated; late-June forward PE was roughly 109x for Giga and 79x for Will.
expectations.thesisExpectation: Alpha requires growth duration and earnings revisions beyond those premium baselines, not merely another strong quarter.
expectations.measurableGap: Company engines are real, but incremental duration room is not proven enough for Primary.

expectationBurdenTest.valuationMethod: Multi-year earnings-duration versus premium forward PE.
expectationBurdenTest.thesisScenario: Product growth and domestic substitution continue to drive earnings materially above the published 2021 path.
expectationBurdenTest.breakevenCondition: Future earnings revisions must outrun multiple compression implied by premium valuation.
expectationBurdenTest.ordinaryScenarioFailure: Companies grow strongly but merely meet the already-premium baseline.
expectationBurdenTest.catalystOrTimingBridge: H1/Q3 earnings and product updates lie within the base horizon.
